BackupsDescription: Saves a snapshot of your database into a folder your cloud client already syncs — Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud. Snapshots are written on quit and once a day.

BackupFolderNotWritable: That folder doesn't exist, or can't be written to
BackupFolderMissing: The backup folder isn't reachable right now. Snapshots will resume once it's back — check that your cloud client is running and signed in.
SnapshotFailed: The snapshot could not be saved

SyncExplanation: Keep this computer and your phone in step through the backup folder above, which your cloud client already shares. Each device writes one small file there and reads the others'. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
SyncNeedsFolder: Choose and save a backup folder above first. Sync goes through the same folder.
SyncNeverWrote: This computer's file not written yet
SyncNothingNew: Nothing new from the other devices
SyncChangesBrought_one: Brought in {{count}} change from the other devices
SyncChangesBrought_other: Brought in {{count}} changes from the other devices
SyncNote: This only says what this computer did. It cannot know whether your cloud client, or another device, has received anything.
SyncTurnOffNote: Turning off only stops this computer. Nothing in the folder is deleted.
SyncNoOtherDevices: No other device has used this folder yet.
SyncDeviceWaiting: {{name}} · holds a different budget. This computer keeps its data and waits for that device to take it.
SyncSkipUnreadable: its file could not be read just now; this computer will try again
SyncSkipChecksum: its file looks damaged or only half written; this computer will try again
SyncSkipNewer: its file was written by a newer version of the app; update this one
SyncSkipTooLarge: its file is too large to read
SyncSkipInvalid: its file holds something this version cannot read
SyncSkipFuture: its file is dated far in the future; check the clock on that device
SyncProblemUnreachable: The folder could not be reached. Check that your cloud client is running and signed in, then try again.
SyncProblemFailed: The changes could not be applied, so nothing was changed. Try again.
SyncProblemPublish: The other devices' changes were merged, but this computer's file could not be written. It will try again.
SyncEnableFailed: Sync could not be changed. Check that the backup folder is saved.
SyncOfferExpired: That device has written since you looked. Review it again.
SyncResolveFailed: That could not be done, so nothing was changed.
SyncFirstLinkBody: This computer and {{name}} each hold a budget the other has never seen. They cannot be merged, so one must take the other's data. The side that changed more recently is suggested.
SyncFirstLinkSafety: A copy of this computer's data is saved first, in the "backups" folder next to the database.
